perspective:
From Christian Mensah’s subjective perspective, he has access to:

- He is a police officer; Jonathan Balogun is his childhood best friend, and Christian often seeks Jonathan’s advice.
- Christian felt Jonathan was hiding something important, became anxious/suspicious, and arranged a meeting at their favorite coffee shop.
- Christian told Jonathan he felt he was hiding something and acting differently. He heard Jonathan admit he had been keeping something from him, was in trouble, and hadn’t known how to tell him.
- Christian felt worried/empathetic and offered help. He heard Jonathan say the situation was complicated and he didn’t want to drag Christian in; Jonathan accepted support/resources and needed to figure a way out.
- Christian suspected the trouble might be criminal-related, felt conflicted/concerned, and decided to investigate discreetly without alarming Jonathan.
- Christian asked Jonathan if it was illegal. He heard Jonathan say he couldn’t be sure, might have gotten involved with wrong people, but claimed he didn’t do anything illegal himself.
- Christian told Jonathan he would look into it discreetly. He heard Jonathan thank him and say he trusted Christian to handle it carefully.
- Christian’s own investigation led him to believe/claim Jonathan was being framed and that someone was trying to set him up. He told Jonathan he had leads but didn’t yet know who.
- Christian decided to gather evidence to prove Jonathan’s innocence. He heard Jonathan thank him and say he didn’t know what he’d do without him.
- Christian later believed/claimed he found out who was behind it: someone both he and Jonathan know and trust. He felt betrayed and resolute, and planned to confront that person and bring them to justice.
- Christian heard Jonathan warn that the person was dangerous, but say he trusted Christian to do what was right.
- Christian’s relevant feelings/beliefs across the story: anxiety/suspicion, worry/empathy, conflict/concern, determination/protectiveness, betrayal/resolution. He knows/believes he has identified a specific culprit close to them, though the supplied dialogue does not name that person.
